cli.add_maintenance_tags_help: Shyiramo inyandikorugero zo kwitabwaho zategetswe hashingiwe ku bibazo byabonetse.
cli.check_backlinks_help: Shaka inyandiko zivuga kuri iyi nyandiko ariko ntizishyireho ihuza.
cli.check_orphan_help: Genzura niba inyandiko ifite amahuza ya wiki ayerekezaho.
cli.check_urls_help: Koresha HEAD kugenzura URL zatanzwe nk'isoko kugira ngo urebe amahuza atagikora (bitinda).
cli.config_help: Inzira igana kuri dosiye y'igenamiterere ya .wiki-mos-audit.toml.
cli.description: Umugenzuzi w'ibanze wa MOS ku mpapuro za Wikipedia.
cli.diff_help: Erekana itandukaniro hagati ya wikitext iri ku rubuga n'iri kuri mudasobwa.
cli.dir_help: Suzuma amadosiye yose ya *-corrected.txt na *.wiki ari mu bubiko.
cli.fix_help: Kosora mu buryo bwikora ibibazo by'imyandikire bidafite ingaruka.
cli.lang_help: Kode y'ururimi rwa UI ku butumwa bwa CLI na raporo (isimbura LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG).
cli.maintenance_tag_help: Ibirango by'inyongera byo kwitabwaho; bitandukanyijwe n'akitso cyangwa bisubirwamo.
cli.offline_help: Simbuka isuzuma ry'amahuza atukura n'ibyo ibyiciro bibaho.
cli.output_wikitext_file_help: Andika wikitext yavuguruwe muri iyi dosiye.
cli.quiet_help: Hagarika ibisohoka bitari amakosa; garagaza kode yo gusohoka gusa.
cli.target_help: URL ya Wikipedia cyangwa umutwe w'inyandiko.
cli.verbose_help: Garagaza amasuzuma ari gukorwa kuri stderr.
cli.wikitext_file_help: Soma wikitext uvuye kuri dosiye iri kuri mudasobwa aho kuyivana kuri API.
